ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across ~80% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) clusters occupying approximately 20% primarily at the tips and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous base. High-intensity contiguous areas located at the extreme distal tips. Dispersed, small, circular high-contrast white rings mapped across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees, clearly dividing the two lobes at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe features larger, irregular valleys and peaks with higher pixel-amplitude variations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward-curving trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring clusters (approx. 12-15) ranging from 10-30 pixels in diameter, distributed across the central dark pigment of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, curved, high-intensity linear mark approximately 150 pixels in length on the right lobe, oriented vertically towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy high-intensity (white) calcified/scarred tissue accumulation at both distal fluke tips; distinct white linear scar on the lower mid-section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial configuration of white circular ring scars against a solid dark background.
